pid_file.description: Absolute path to the file where the daemon writes its process ID.

max_worker_threads.description: Maximum number of concurrent worker threads for event handling.

operation_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before aborting a monitoring or recovery operation.

daemonize.description: Whether to run as a background daemon (detach from controlling terminal).

monitored_devices.description: List of device-mapper devices to monitor (e.g., LVs, thin pools). Each entry includes the device path and optional flags.

flags.description: Optional comma-separated flags (e.g., 'mirror', 'thin-pool', 'snapshot') to specify monitoring mode.

lvm2_path.description: Path to the `lvm` binary used for performing recovery actions.

state_dir.description: Directory used to store runtime state (e.g., recovery status, logs).

use_udev.description: Whether to wait for udev to settle before performing device operations.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of attempts to retry a failed operation before giving up.
